rules:
How your journey grows

Small wins. Complete a saved task or routine step to add one active day. More checkoffs add small wins, but not extra days. Repeat checkoffs of the same item on the same day count once.

Milestones stay with you. Levels follow your total recorded active days: 0, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 60. Level 1 is your starting point. Days don’t need to be consecutive. A break never erases earlier activity. Undoing a checkoff corrects the totals.

Your local day. Streaks count consecutive active days. Yesterday’s streak stays current until the end of today in America/New_York. This page celebrates recorded activity; it does not measure your health or your worth.

Fictional sample progress. Preview changes reset when you reload. Daily encouragement is written by Tempo, not generated from personal records.
